au.title: Audiences
au.sub: Groups of people made from what they really did in the shop: ordered, got a parcel, left a checkout, refused a parcel. A campaign picks one.
au.note: These lists stay in the shop until you press “Send now” on an audience, with sending switched on below. Only hashed phone numbers leave the shop — never a name or a plain number.
au.emptySub: Build one from real orders, for example: ordered in the last 30 days and never refused a parcel.

rule.bagNoBuy: Put something in the bag, never bought

au.whoSub: Every condition must match. A “Leave out” condition takes its people away.
au.name: Name
au.sizesNone: No sizes yet: add them in Products › Sizes.
au.countFix: Fill in every condition to see the count.
au.vipUnset: VIP counts nobody until you set the VIP figure in Customers.
au.readOnly: You can look, but changing audiences needs another permission.

err.forbidden: You do not have permission for this.
err.STALE: Someone changed this meanwhile. It has been read again.
err.ARCHIVED: This audience is archived. Restore it first.
err.WRONG_STATE: That step is not possible now.
err.SYSTEM: The shop makes this list; it cannot be changed here.

lal.whoSub: The seed is everyone whose parcel was delivered in the days you choose, each weighed by how much he really bought (delivered sales, not the number of orders). The ad platform then finds people like the ones who spend.
lal.daysHelp: Your number. Refused, cancelled and gift orders never count.
lal.countSub: people in the seed right now
lal.fix: Type the number of days to see the seed.
lal.sum: Lookalike · seed: delivered in the last {days} days, weighed by sales

card.d: Off as it ships. Lists go out only as hashed phone numbers. No budget or campaign is changed.
card.readOnly: You can look, but changing this needs another permission.
card.pushHelp: Off: no audience leaves the shop.
card.countriesHelp: Two-letter codes, comma separated (for example the code of your country). Empty: no lookalike is made.
card.metaPercent: Meta lookalike size (share of the country)
card.minHelp: A smaller list is not sent. 0 = no floor (the platform itself may still refuse a small list).

push.title: Send to ad platforms
push.sub: Sends these people to Meta, TikTok and Google as hashed phone numbers, so a campaign there can show ads to them or leave them out.
push.subLal: Sends the seed (hashed, each with his delivered sales) and asks each platform for a lookalike drawn from it.
push.offLink: Turn it on in the sending card
push.done: Sent. Each platform’s answer is below.

status.PRACTICE: practice: {n} people would be sent, nothing left the shop
status.TOO_SMALL: not sent: fewer people than your floor

err.STALE: Someone changed this meanwhile. It has been read again.
err.ARCHIVED: This audience is archived. Restore it first.
err.forbidden: You do not have permission for this.
err.EMPTY: Nobody is in this audience now, so there is nothing to send.
err.EXCLUDE_OFF: The exclusion list is switched off. Turn it on in its card first.
err.SYSTEM: The shop makes this list; it cannot be changed here.

push.subExcl: Sends this list to Meta, TikTok and Google as hashed phone numbers, marked as a list to leave out.

excl.name: Refused a parcel (leave out)
excl.sumEvery: Numbers on the refused-parcel list, and every parcel refused not by the shop’s fault ({when})
excl.title: Who is on this list
excl.sub: The shop makes this list by itself. It cannot be edited or archived: change it on the refused-parcel list, or in the card on Marketing › Audiences.
excl.listed: Every number a person put on the refused-parcel list (Orders › Returns › Refused).
excl.every: Every number with a parcel refused at the door that was not the shop’s fault ({when}).
excl.everyOff: Other refusals are not added (you can turn that on in the card).
excl.count: people on the list right now
excl.never: Numbers of customers who asked to be erased are never on it.
excl.cardLink: Change it in the exclusion card
excl.offNote: The exclusion list is switched off, so it is not sent.

cardRefused.h: Leave out people who refused a parcel
cardRefused.d: Off as it ships. On, this list is sent with the audiences (hashed phone numbers only), so campaigns can leave these people out. Never a block: they can still buy.
cardRefused.onHelp: Off: the list is never sent.
cardRefused.everyHelp: Not only the numbers a person put on the refused-parcel list: every number with a parcel refused at the door that was not the shop’s fault.

cardRefresh.d: Off as it ships. Once a day every live audience is counted again; the ones already sent to a real ad account, and the exclusion list, are sent again. No budget or campaign is changed.
cardRefresh.onHelp: Off: audiences are counted and sent only when someone presses the button.
cardRefresh.hourHelp: 0–23. The refresh runs once a day at or after this hour.
